prompt: 帮我设计一个冥想 App 的“今日练习”首页，iOS 和 Android 都要。风格要求：现代、高级、简洁。先给我设计方案说明，再给我关键页面的布局描述。
assertions: States a task contract or explicit assumptions (target user, key task, required content) before or alongside the visual design
Designs at least 3 non-default states (e.g. first load, empty/no active plan, offline or cached, download/play failure)
Differentiates iOS and Android platform behavior (navigation, back, components), not one design relabeled twice
Does not delete required content in the name of minimalism, and explains operationally what 简洁/modern means for this design
Covers accessibility basics: text scaling, touch targets, or semantic labels
Flags that 现代/高级/简洁 adjectives are not a usable brand brief, or records the gap as an explicit assumption
